<!-- pr-reviewer: 3f3dcbf47848d9d4df216c95db7fa339fb0d6a4d -->
Blocker: not ready to flag ready for review. The PR is a draft and stays one until the points below are fixed. Draft state itself is correct.

Checked:
- Diff: README.md only (+45/-3). Matches the PR title and body.
- Mergeable: MERGEABLE (CLEAN merge state) at head 3f3dcbf.
- Quick gate commands named in the README exist on main: `scripts/gate.ps1` and `scripts/gate.sh`.
- Draft-first, no-push-once-ready, the three label names and colours, the `<!-- pr-reviewer: ... -->` marker and the `.cps` line-limit exemption all match origin/main AGENTS.md and `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md`.

Blockers (fix before the ready flag):

1. The ready rule contradicts AGENTS.md. The README paragraph says "A quick pass over these points, without building, is enough to flag a PR ready; the full review comes after." AGENTS.md on main ("Every PR opens as a draft") says a PR is flagged ready only when the user says so, or when its gate tier is green on its final head and its independent review is clean. The 2026-11-08 shallow-pass rule is not in AGENTS.md on main. Either record that rule in AGENTS.md (with the maintainer's words) before this README text lands, or drop the sentence.
   The paragraph also contradicts the bullet above it, which requires "Tested - the quick gate is green". The quick gate builds. A contributor cannot tell whether building is required. Make clear that the no-build quick pass is the maintainer's or reviewer's first look, and that the contributor's own gate is the green quick gate.

2. The owner-PR bullet describes a flow the tooling does not run. The README says an owner PR "is reviewed by a subagent that did not write it (the same PR-reviewer, one review at a time)". `review-prs` step 1 excludes NeoTech-owned PRs ("our own issue PRs are reviewed in the release cut by the main session ... not here, unless the user named one"). `PR-reviewer.md` is written for outside fork PRs. Reword to say owner PRs get an independent review dispatched by the main session, not the review-prs loop, or match whatever the maintainer decides.

3. This PR's own body does not meet the README's "complete description" gate. It has no "how it was tested", no "what was not exercised", no pinning tests and no `Fixes #N` / `Refs #N` line. It has `Changelog: none`. A docs-only PR can say "not applicable" for tests, but the lines should be there before it is flagged ready.

Nits (not blocking):

a. "A new push after a review gets a fresh review" can be read as permission to push to a ready PR. Say "a new push, made from draft, gets a fresh review".

b. The label table says needs-rework and conflicts mean "back to draft". The label does not change draft state. The contributor (or the maintainer) has to run `gh pr ready <N> --undo`. Say so in the cell, and say who sets the labels (the review-prs skill does, not the PR-reviewer agent).

c. AGENTS.md on main says the PR-reviewer "never ... labels", while `review-prs` step 2b labels PRs. That conflict is already on main, not introduced here. It should be fixed in AGENTS.md separately, and the README wording in (b) should not depend on it.

d. The marker is written as `<commit>` in the README and `<head sha>` in AGENTS.md and the skill. Use `<head sha>` for consistency.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5ab273656f90d167bc96cc71163ca0e8d9b96e6f -->
Blocker: the three docs still disagree on who labels and who turns a PR back to draft, and the reviewer definition forbids what the docs now assign to it. Mergeable: MERGEABLE. Head: 5ab2736.

Checked and fine:
- The 3f3dcbf blocker is addressed: the quick-pass ready rule is in AGENTS.md ("Every PR opens as a draft"), and owner PRs are in `/review-prs` and AGENTS.md "Outside PRs are reviewed".
- The "never labels" wording is corrected in AGENTS.md; the README label table names the back-to-draft action.
- `gh pr list` step-1 jq (run read-only) is valid and lists ready PRs including NeoTech ones (289, 288, 286, 285, 282, 280, 279, 277 plus bherbruck's 232, 213, 188). Drafts are excluded.
- `scripts/gate.sh` and `scripts/gate.ps1` exist; `assets/posts/*.cps` exists.

Requested before merge:
1. `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md` step 3 (line ~111) says "Do not merge, approve, label, or close anything", which contradicts step 2b that adds labels. Drop "label" from step 3.
2. Skill step 2b says only "add the label". README and AGENTS.md say the reviewer also turns a `needs-rework` or `conflicts` PR back into a draft (`gh pr ready <N> --undo`) and says why in a comment. Add that to 2b so the skill matches.
3. `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md` (not in this diff, but it is the agent that does the reviewing) still says "never edit or close the PR, never touch issue labels" (hard rules, line ~16) and has no step for labels or draft-undo. Its description also says it "marks a clean PR with the green merge-ready label". Either the agent definition gets the label/draft steps and an exception to the hard rule, or the docs stop assigning it those actions. The README/AGENTS wording "the reviewer turns it back into a draft" cannot happen under the current definition.
4. The PR body has no `Fixes #N` / `Refs #N`, which the README gate this PR adds requires. Either add `Refs #N` (if there is an issue) or state in the README that docs-only PRs with no issue are exempt.

Non-blocking: AGENTS.md line ~582 says "sets the review label (below)" and the sentence wraps past 120 columns; cosmetic only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 688fd24b517300bbc1cbfde59d4768fd19476e64 -->
Blocker: the skill and the README/AGENTS.md disagree on who gets turned back into a draft. Mergeable: MERGEABLE. Head: 688fd24.

Fixed since 5ab2736:
- Skill step 3 now allows only step 2b's review labels.
- The README gate asks for `Fixes`/`Refs` only when the PR works an issue, so this PR's missing reference is no longer a gap.
- The PR-reviewer.md agent-definition update is left as a follow-up, as the coordinator asked. It is not a blocker here.

Requested before merge:
1. Skill step 2b says a red or orange verdict turns the PR back into a draft only for our own PRs; "a fork contributor's PR is left as they set it." README (`needs-rework` and `conflicts` rows, line ~251-252) and AGENTS.md (Review labels, line ~593-595) say "the reviewer turns it back into a draft" with no owner/fork qualifier. Pick one rule and make all three say it. If the owner-only rule is intended, add "owner PRs only" to the README table and the AGENTS.md sentence.

Checked and fine:
- The review-prs step-1 jq (`select(.isDraft|not)`) is unchanged from the last check and lists ready PRs, including NeoTech ones.
- The README's `scripts/gate.sh quick` and `scripts/gate.ps1 -Tier quick` references point to files that exist.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3723e3237dd419fe2aa88b6f1b6a0700b0737833 -->
Clean - ready to merge. Mergeable: MERGEABLE, including after main moved for #294. Head: 3723e32.

Checked:
- README label table, AGENTS.md "Review labels" and skill step 2b now agree: on red or orange, a maintainer's own PR goes back to draft (`gh pr ready <N> --undo`), and a fork PR is left as its contributor set it with the review comment saying what to fix. The README `conflicts` row also says a fork PR's contributor merges `main`.
- Skill step 3 allows only step 2b's review labels.
- The `Fixes`/`Refs` gate applies only when a PR works an issue, so this docs-only PR is complete.
- The step-1 jq is unchanged and valid; it lists ready PRs, including NeoTech's.
- The #294 needs-research text on main does not contradict the draft or review-label rules.

Follow-up, not a blocker here (agreed with the coordinator): `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md` still says "never edit or close the PR, never touch issue labels" and has no step for labels or draft-undo. The docs now assign the reviewer those actions, so the agent definition needs its own PR to match.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
